name: Cascadis Operational Composite Scenario Policy

default_assumptions.wue_basis: Google 2024 ISO WUE Category 2 fleet proxy for data centers supporting LLM models

methodology_notes: PUE and WUE targets and upper anchors are internal screening values, not industry standards.
CUE is displayed and filterable but receives no direct composite weight because it already contains PUE and grid intensity.
Missing site metrics use explicit editable proxies and retain their evidence basis.

sources.title: Google Data Centers efficiency — 2026 Q1 PUE report
Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale
